blockingIssues.description: `switchPersistedProfileBaseUrl` falls back to the previous node's auth and enterprise credentials when the target base URL has no cached entry, so `flux node use-base-url`/`use-gateway` can retain stale credentials and does not fully satisfy the per-base-url credential-adoption contract in VAL-NODE-003.
